titulo_es: Ask for help in a window

texto: When you go to a citizen service («de balie» or «het loket»), the reason is announced: «Ik heb een afspraak» (I have an appointment) or «Ik wil dit formulier invullen» (I want to fill out this form). The employee's courtesy expressions include: «Neem plaats» (take a seat) and «Een collega helpt u zo» (a partner will attend you right away).

frases.nl: Goedemorgen, ik heb een afspraak om tien uur.
frases.es: Buenos días, tengo una cita a las diez.
frases.en: Good morning, I have a date at 10.

frases.nl: Bij welk loket moet u zijn?
frases.en: What window do you have to go to?

frases.nl: Ik wil ook dit formulier invullen.
frases.en: I also want to fill out this form.

frases.nl: Neem plaats; een collega helpt u zo.
frases.es: Tome asiento; un compañero le atenderá enseguida.
frases.en: Have a seat; a partner will be with you in a minute.

frases.nl: Dank u. Moet ik hier wachten?
frases.en: Thank you. Do I have to wait here?

bloques.pregunta: What courteous invitation does the official make for the user to be comfortable?

opciones.explicacion: «Plaatsnemen» is the standard expression of courtesy to invite you to sit down.

opciones.texto: Ga naar huis (márchese a su domicilio)
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't tell her to leave, but to have a seat.

opciones.texto: Vul het opnieuw in (rellénelo desde el principio)
opciones.explicacion: He tells you that a partner will come to help him.

bloques.pregunta: What further procedure does the visitor wish to take?
bloques.frase: Ik wil ook dit formulier invullen.

opciones.explicacion: «Een formulier invullen» means filling out a form.
He doesn't mention the transport ticket.
It is not a question of paying sanctions.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the noun of the formula to take a seat.
bloques.frase: Neem ___; een collega helpt u zo.

opciones.explicacion: «Neem plaats» is the fixed location for «Take a seat.».

bloques.pregunta: What does the employee say in his first answer?
bloques.frase: Bij welk loket moet u zijn?

opciones.texto: What particular window should the citizen address.
opciones.explicacion: «Bij welk loket» asks about the designated window.

opciones.texto: What language you prefer to speak during your attention
opciones.explicacion: Do not consult for language preferences.

opciones.texto: How much money you have in cash for the rates
opciones.explicacion: He does not ask for money.

bloques.pregunta: It is complete with the word that designates the co-worker who will serve the citizen.

opciones.explicacion: «Een collega» is a partner or colleague of the service.

bloques.frase: Goedemorgen, ik heb een afspraak om tien uur
bloques.traduccion: Good morning, I have a date at 10.
bloques.explicacion: A formal morning greeting and a statement of appointment with a precise time.

intro: He requests attention at a municipal window or desk and includes staff information.
